## SCHEDULE E

## SUMMER SCHOOL

Summer school payment for teaching services rendered during summer scholl will be at the rate of $9 per hour.

## SCHEDULE F

## SUBSTITUTES

The perdiem salary of substitute teachers shall be $35.00.
